_comment: Labels every managed repo has ('all'), plus a repo's own. The issue forms add their label; the automation adds needs-fields, settings-drift and claude-md-drift; a person adds confirmed (design 6.1). apply-rules.py creates or updates them, verify-settings.py checks name, colour and description. Labels not listed (GitHub's defaults) are left alone.

all.name: triage
all.description: Bug not yet triaged into an intent or a task

all.name: confirmed
all.description: A person checked this critical or high audit finding's evidence (design 6.1)

all.name: deferred
all.description: Audit finding deferred to a later phase, with the reason on the issue

all.name: needs-fields
all.description: Missing or invalid form answers; kept out of planning views

.github.name: claude-md-drift
.github.description: A CLAUDE.md names a design section that no longer exists

.github.name: peras-tests-broken
.github.description: A change to .github's main broke peras's agent-hook tests
